row: Healing HEART Sanctuary is a sanctuary for disabled animals.  Children are invited to come to Healing HEART Sanctuary, whenever possible, to help in the healing and rehab of the animals. The children usually have either mental, physical, emotional, and/or attitudinal challenges.  Helping some other being get back on its feet can be the biggest step to getting yourself out of your own way and back on your own feet.
